Reproduces #64 end-to-end with two REAL feature files (not lib/rowState.js in isolation - see rowstate-selfcheck.html for that): a row that trips BOTH hideLongTracks and hideTracksInPlaylist at once, using in-playlist-track from mocks/data.js (already in 2 playlists, 4:00 long) with the long-tracks threshold lowered to 2 minutes so it also qualifies as "too long". Before the fix, clicking "show" would only dismiss ONE filter's reason, and the other filter would immediately re-hide the row on the very rescan the click itself triggers. See test/README.md.
